purpose: Implement a pure-read Success Memory lens over durable CORE-02 LearningMemory so N0TE can recall what appeared to help under what conditions, with sample size, counterexamples, confounders and reported confidence, without turning observed association into a causal rule.

lineage.outcome: N0TE remembers what appeared to help in the artist's own work, including contradictory and inconclusive examples, conditions, confounders and reported confidence, without manufacturing causal certainty or superstition.
lineage.capability: Success Memory synthesis with causality humility

completion_proof: one completed KEEP remains SINGLE_OBSERVATION with an explicit thin-evidence warning
repeated KEEP-only evidence becomes SUCCESS_ONLY with an explicit absence-of-counterexamples/survivorship warning rather than causal proof
KEEP plus REVERT or REVISE becomes MIXED and retains counterexample episode provenance
patterns with completed REVERT/REVISE but no KEEP become NO_KEEP_EVIDENCE and all-inconclusive patterns remain INCONCLUSIVE_ONLY
unfinished Learning episodes remain visible as pending but do not increase completed sample size
conditions and alternative explanations/confounders are counted by distinct episode and retain episode provenance
consequence summaries retain source kinds, source references, Song IDs and reported confidence summaries
comparable patterns group only by exact normalized domain + subject_ref + change_description; unrelated subject/change values never merge
Song-scoped synthesis cannot leak another Song while artist-wide synthesis can merge the same exact pattern with source Song IDs preserved
causal_status is ASSOCIATION_ONLY and no recommendation/ranking/causal rule API exists
Success Memory creates no persistence tables and repeated reads write zero rows; restart yields the same synthesis
next_selection_rule: After CORE-02E evidence, audit CORE-02A-E against every mapped CORE-02 requirement. Close CORE-02 as a construction dependency only if the remaining foundation contract is actually satisfied; otherwise select exactly the uncovered requirement. Then globally reselect across PLATFORM-00, DAW-00, APP/UX readiness and other dependency-ready work.
